subject: Lon Lon Ranch
text: Link can escape Lon Lon Ranch by running counter-clockwise around the pasture track on Epona and burning all six carrots to jump over the closed gate.

evidence.quote: Return to the track going around the pasture, and run around it in a counter-clockwise direction (the opposite direction you go in the race)...When you reach the last turn in the course and can see the gate directly in front of you, burn all six of your carrots at once and run straight at the gate.  If you aim yourself properly you'll soar right over the gate and Epona will now be yours to use in Hyrule Field, Lake Hylia, Gerudo Valley and Lon Lon Ranch.

subject: Epona
text: Playing Epona's Song makes Epona appear.

evidence.quote: Simply play Epona's Song to make her appear.

subject: Transportation Songs
text: Playing any Transportation Song automatically sets the timer on any timed trading items to 0:01.

evidence.quote: Using any of the Transportation Songs (Prelude of Light, Minuet of Forest, etc.) will automatically set the timer on any Timed Items to 0:01.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: The Cucco Lady standing near the pasture by the entrance to Kakariko Graveyard gives Link the Pocket Egg.

evidence.quote: In order to obtain the Pocket Egg, head for Kakariko Village and speak with the Cucco Lady.  She is standing near the pasture in the rear of town, near the entrance to the Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Pocket Egg
text: Playing the Sun's Song hatches the Pocket Egg into the Pocket Cucco.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Pocket Egg, play the Sun's Song until the Pocket Egg hatches into the Pocket Cucco.

subject: Talon
text: Using the Pocket Cucco near Talon while he is sleeping inside the building at the bottom of the stairs wakes him up.

evidence.quote: Make sure that it is daytime, then enter the building at the bottom of the stairs near the middle of town.  Talon is sleeping on the bed.  Use the Pocket Cucco while standing near Talon, and he will awaken.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Showing the hatched Pocket Cucco to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village earns Cojiro.

evidence.quote: Return to the Cucco Lady and show her the Pocket Cucco, and she'll give you Cojiro, the Blue Cucco.

subject: Carpenter's Son
text: Showing Cojiro to the Carpenter's Son in the Lost Woods rewards Link with the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote: Show him Cojiro, and the Carpenter's Son will admit that he has been cursed, and the only cure is a Potion which must be made from an Odd Mushroom.  He'll give you the Odd Mushroom.

subject: Hag
text: Showing the Odd Mushroom to the Hag behind the Kakariko Potion Shop turns it into the Odd Potion within a 3:00 time limit.

evidence.quote: Time Limit: 3:00 ... The Odd Mushroom is on a three minute time limit, so you have to high tail it back to Kakariko Village.

subject: Kokiri Girl
text: Giving the Odd Potion to the Kokiri Girl in the Lost Woods rewards Link with the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: Give the Kokiri Girl the Odd Potion, and she'll give you the Poacher's Saw.

subject: Carpenter
text: Showing the Poacher's Saw to the Carpenter outside the tent in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Speak with the Carpenter on the other side of the bridge, standing outside of the tent, and then show him the Poacher's Saw.  He'll recognize it as his own, and give you the Broken Goron's Sword.

subject: Biggoron
text: Showing the Broken Goron's Sword to Biggoron at the peak of Death Mountain prompts him to ask for medicinal eyedrops from King Zora.

evidence.quote: Once you're at the peak, arouse Biggoron's attention by standing on the right side of the cliff, and then show him the Broken Goron's Sword.  He'll admit that he'd love to  repair the Sword, but he can't because the last eruption blinded him.  You'll have to get some medicinal eyedrops from the King Zora first.

subject: Potion Shop
text: A Blue Flame can be purchased from the Potion Shop in Kakariko Village for 300 rupees.

evidence.quote: You have two options to unfreeze King Zora: you can either go to Kakariko Village and purchase a Blue Flame from the Potion Shop there (for a hefty 300 rupee price tag), or you can head for the Ice Cavern ahead of schedule and get a Blue Flame for free.

subject: Freezzard
text: Defeating three Freezzards in the first room of the Ice Cavern with sword strikes or Din's Fire opens the locked door.

evidence.quote: Enter the Ice Cavern, and run down the passage to the first room.  Kill the three Freezzard's in the room using sword strikes or Din's Fire while dodging the Blade Trap.  Enter the door that opens.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collecting all Silver Rupees in the rotating ice blade room of the Ice Cavern unlocks the next door.

evidence.quote: Run down the hall to the next room, which contains a large blade made of ice that rotates steadily.  Gather all of the Silver Rupees in the room, and enter the door that opens.

subject: Blue Fire
text: A pillar of Blue Fire can be captured in an empty bottle on the second level of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Run to the end of this passage, and in the next room run along the different platforms to the pillar of Blue Fire on the second level...Capture the Blue Fire in a bottle, and return to the King Zora.

subject: King Zora
text: Unfreezing King Zora with Blue Fire and presenting the Prescription gives Link the Eyeball Frog.

evidence.quote: Use the bottle of Blue Fire while standing next to the King to unfreeze him.  Show him the Prescription, and he'll give you the ingredients needed.
The Eyeball Frog must be delivered to the scientist in the Observatory at Lake Hylia in less then three minutes.

subject: Scientist
text: Delivering the Eyeball Frog to the scientist in the Lake Hylia Observatory within 3:00 yields the Eyedrops.

evidence.quote: Part VIII: The Eyeball Frog...Time Limit: 3:00...Step inside and show the Scientist the Eyeball Frog, and after mistaking them for his dinner, he'll make you the Eyedrops.
